items.q: What does Picard mean by "we are energy"?
items.a: Not a metaphor — energy flows through ~**5,000 trillion mitochondria**. Health is **proper allocation** across a **finite energy budget** hierarchy. Business and life decisions are literally **energetic allocations**.

items.q: Is it stress that burns us down?
items.a: "It's not the stress that burns us down, it's the **response to stress**." Rumination/worry about past/future raised measured energy expenditure ~**60%** in lab studies, stealing from **growth, maintenance, and repair**.
Yes within a **gray-hair reversal window** — reversible if stress lifts before a threshold; **10-year-old gray** is unlikely to re-darken. Picard personally reversed gray on a **cycling vacation**.

items.q: What does hair encode about your life?
items.a: Hair is a **biological diary** — stress graphs can correlate pixel-perfect with depigmentation; proteomic segments can reflect toxins/events (e.g. marijuana months prior). "We all walk around with our **biological history** encoded in your hair."

items.q: How does the energy-resistance frame unify disease?
items.a: Cancer, Alzheimer's, and diabetes appear as **increased resistance to energy flow**. Cancer cells exit the organism's **social contract**, hoard energy, and revert to selfish replication; hyperglycemia pushes excess electrons → resistance → damage.

items.q: Why can alcohol feel relaxing while draining you?
items.a: The **alcohol paradox**: you feel relaxed while the body burns energy **detoxing ethanol minute-by-minute**. Immune battles (flu/COVID) similarly **steal energy** from the brain → fatigue and foggy thinking.

items.q: Does purpose change the brain's mitochondria?
items.a: Bidirectional: post-mortem brains with **greater purpose** show lower resistance / higher transformation capacity in executive regions. "If you feel more life purpose, the mitochondria in your brain can **flow energy more easily** — or the inverse."

items.q: Why do ketones show up in metabolic psychiatry?
items.a: Ketones can **ease electron flow**; dozens of treatment-resistant schizoaffective/bipolar/MDD cases report life-changing energy/clarity. Lactate injection can trigger panic/PTSD — tricking the body into an **energetic crisis** without touching neurochemistry directly.

items.q: Does Picard endorse NAD, CoQ10, or urolithin A stacks?
items.a: He acknowledges urolithin A JAMA muscle-endurance RCTs but maintains **mitochondrial-supplement skepticism** — deficiency-responsive only; high-dose antioxidants can **impair adaptation**. "I trust the wisdom of my body and my mitochondria more than I trust the pharma company trying to sell **urolithin A**."

items.q: What lifestyle levers does he actually trust?
items.a: Stack: **purpose, exercise, sleep**, fasting/vacation recovery, ketones for some, **interoception** to interrupt stress responses, and natural light when possible (vitamin D in "dark bunker" modern life).
